XECH Double Channel Keyboard – Smart Wireless Keyboard for Work & Entertainment

The XECH Double Channel Keyboard is designed for modern multitaskers who need speed, comfort, and seamless device switching. Built with advanced wireless technology, this universal compatibility keyboard allows you to connect and work across two devices effortlessly. Whether you are using a smartphone, tablet, laptop, or smart TV, this keyboard ensures smooth performance, long battery life, and clutter-free productivity.

With an extended wireless range and intelligent power management, the is ideal for home offices, travel, online classes, and entertainment setups. The sleek design combined with practical features like an integrated phone and tablet stand makes it a perfect all-in-one wireless keyboard solution.

Instant Switch Between 2 Devices with Double Channel Technology

The instant switch between 2 devices feature allows you to toggle between connected devices with a single key press. Easily move from typing on your tablet to replying on your smartphone without disconnecting or re-pairing. This improves workflow efficiency and reduces downtime, making it ideal for professionals and students alike.

Universal Compatibility Across Multiple Platforms

This universal compatibility works seamlessly with Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Chrome OS. Whether you need a or a compact for your laptop, the Double Channel adapts to your ecosystem effortlessly. It supports popular devices such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, desktops, and smart TVs, making it a versatile accessory for daily use. No additional drivers or software are required—just connect and start typing instantly.

Stable Wireless Range for Hassle-Free Typing

Enjoy uninterrupted connectivity with a reliable wireless range that ensures stable performance even at a distance. The maintains a strong signal for smooth typing, presentations, and media control, reducing lag and input delay. This makes it an excellent choice for conference rooms, classrooms, and living room setups.

Auto Sleep Feature for Extended Battery Life

The built-in auto sleep feature intelligently conserves power by putting the into sleep mode when not in use. This enhances battery efficiency and reduces the need for frequent charging or battery replacement. Simply press any key to wake the keyboard instantly and resume work. This energy-efficient is perfect for users who value long-lasting performance and low maintenance.

Integrated Phone and Tablet Stand for Better Ergonomics

The included phone and tablet stand provides a comfortable viewing angle for typing, video calls, and content consumption. This ergonomic design reduces neck strain and improves posture, making it ideal for long work sessions and online meetings.

  • Double channel wireless keyboard for two devices
  • Universal compatibility with Android, iOS, Windows & macOS
  • Instant switch between 2 devices
  • Stable long wireless range
  • Smart auto sleep feature for power saving
  • Built-in phone and tablet stand
  • Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly design

Why Choose?

The combines functionality, style, and reliability in one compact device. Designed for users who demand flexibility, it serves as a perfect wireless keyboard for tablet and phone while also functioning efficiently with laptops and desktops. Its responsive keys, durable build, and minimalistic design make it suitable for both professional and personal use.

Whether you are working remotely, studying online, or enjoying entertainment, this delivers consistent performance with effortless device control. Upgrade your workspace with a smarter typing solution that adapts to your lifestyle.
